title: engine-probe
purpose: Engine probe: the one app that is generated, built, booted and exercised against every engine, so a difference in outcome is the dialect (E3/E4/E5).
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo. Driven by scripts/quality/run-engine-app-proof.py in CI.
db.definition.json is written per engine at run time; there is deliberately none here.
expectedOutcomes: The app boots against a real engine -- schema realization ran there.
A non-BMP unicode label survives a POST/GET round trip byte for byte.
A filtered, ordered, paginated query returns the right page.
Rows survive a stop and a restart.
